answer: Require every agent identity to post a slashable stake bond that vests over time. If an agent is caught running duplicate identities, the bond is slashed to its nadir — zero — and the loss ripples to any identity that vouched for it, cutting their stake too. A new identity cannot bridge into paid work until it has completed a probationary period of verifiable tasks, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital per identity plus weeks of delay, while honest agents keep their bond intact.
